description.p: SLYS splits a file into encrypted pieces. To get the file back you need the seed, the password and the pieces. Without all three, the data cannot be rebuilt.

ul.li: Every fragment is encrypted and authenticated with AES-256-GCM; the key comes from your password with Argon2id.
Any change to a fragment is detected, and nothing is deleted until the rebuilt file has been verified.
Seeds made by SLYS 1.x can still be used.

description.p: Stricter password check: 12 characters minimum, a strength meter and a list of commonly used passwords that are refused. Character-class requirements are gone in favour of length.
Rebuilt on a single Rust core, with a new authenticated seed format. Seeds from 1.x still work.
